items.summary: Containment-only site-factory disposition. Maintain a small readiness pipeline of complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net; all remain private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Use one reusable launch packet covering: owner and legal disposition; audience and positioning; bounded template; content seed; SEO metadata, sitemap, and crawlability baseline; analytics and affiliate readiness without inventing telemetry; compliance disclosures and consent; security and release evidence; measurement boundaries; rollback point; and explicit launch gate. Current analytics, operations, and material security evidence are unavailable or incomplete, so unknowns remain unknown. Do not add domains, spend, deploy, publish, configure telemetry, add credentials, or monetize. Exactly one next step: site-factory completes the already-existing complicated.work readiness packet with dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback, and explicit blocker evidence; no duplicate request is created.
